subject: Ochre - sneezing fits after the park
body:
Hi APS team,

I wanted to flag something I've been noticing with Ochre. Since the past few weeks, she has been having sneezing fits, mostly after our walks to the park. They usually start a few minutes after we get back and last for a short while before she settles down. She doesn't seem to be in any distress otherwise, and her appetite and energy look normal to me.

I'm not sure whether this is seasonal or something she picked up outside, so I'd appreciate your guidance on a few things:

- Should I keep a log of when the sneezing happens and how long it lasts?
- Is there anything I should watch for that would mean I need to call a vet right away?
- Would you like me to bring her in for a check, or wait and see how it goes?

Thanks for helping me keep an eye on her.

Lorenzo

subject: APS Rescue_10/22_Shelter pull from San Benito County Animal Services
body:
Hi everyone!

We did it! TEN dogs pulled from the shelter today, and I couldn't be more grateful to all of you for making room. (I may have cried a little in the parking lot. Just a little.)

Here's the crew:
Sepia (young F chihuahua mix, small); Marl (puppy F heeler mix, medium); Hollow (puppy M shepherd mix, small); Mallow (senior F heeler mix, medium); Chert (adult M lab mix, small); Tuff (senior M lab mix, medium); Playa (adult M shepherd mix, medium); Pike (senior F heeler mix, medium); Woad (puppy F heeler mix, medium); Flax (senior F lab mix, large).

Pickup is at the den (our Redwood City safehouse) between 4-7pm!

At intake everyone got DHPP + Bordetella, deworming, and flea treatment.

What we DON'T know: no records came with them. So PLEASE keep new pups separated from resident dogs for now and watch closely. Tell me anything you notice!

You all are amazing.

Dana

She's also become our dinner-time vocalist. Every evening around six she sits at the kitchen doorway and sings until her bowl hits the floor. It's loud, but it's become a good reminder that dinner is coming. If the adopter asks about her routine, I'm happy to describe it.

Let me know if you need anything else for her profile.

Silas

subject: Gypsum update!
body:
Hi there!!

No need to write back, I just wanted to share the joy with the people who helped get her here. Thanks again for everything!!

Gavin

Cerulean (young M spaniel mix, medium)
